title: The bar MacMahon
html_source:
A bar in Paris.

This memory of meeting Patrice in Paris is triggered by the sight of the Pigeonhouse, which brings to mind the “c'est le pigeon” joke, which comes from a book Patrice promised to send Stephen (La Vie de Jesus).

anchor.prefix:
ssed the firmer sand towards the Pigeonhouse. 

— Qui vous a mis dans cette fichue position? 

— C'est le pigeon, Joseph.
